lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
A centred mug drawing has three clear values and a scratchy handle. What would a kind four-part critique say about it?

FEEDBACK
I see a centred mug, three values, and a scratchy handle, and the centre placement feels formal and still. That formal aim seems deliberate because the mug is isolated with even space around it. One revision is to rebuild the handle from its air gap so the scratchy loop matches the mug you can see.

WATCH FOR
Critique means saying you like it or that it is bad, without describing a visible choice or offering one change to try.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Critique a pencil drawing of a lace-up boot that sits low on the page, with a heavy outline and a large empty top half. Use description, one analysis, a cautious intent and one kind revision. Do not score it out of ten.

Write a short reflection naming one artistic choice you changed and why. Movement or instrument work is optional, adult-supervised and can be described instead.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Ava describes a bottle drawing, analyses the left placement, and offers one kind revision. She writes: I see a bottle left of centre and a dark shadow to the right. The left placement leaves open space, which seems to aim for a calm picture because the shadow has room to travel. One change to try is softening the outline where the shadow meets the bottle, so that edge is not equally heavy all the way around.

TRY FIRST
A centred mug drawing has three clear values and a scratchy handle. What would a kind four-part critique say about it?

FEEDBACK
I see a centred mug, three values, and a scratchy handle, and the centre placement feels formal and still. That formal aim seems deliberate because the mug is isolated with even space around it. One revision is to rebuild the handle from its air gap so the scratchy loop matches the mug you can see.
teach_steps.explain:
A useful critique describes, analyses one choice, interprets intent and suggests one revision. Describe only what is visible. Analyse means explaining one choice, such as placement or line weight. Interpret with evidence, using seems to, because you cannot see a private thought. The revision is one kind, specific change, aimed at the drawing rather than at the person.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make intentional visual, music, drama or dance choices and name their effect, rather than saying an artwork is simply “nice”. Keep every claim linked to an element or technique.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the elements, techniques or performance choices that carry the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. For movement or instruments, use a clear space, ask an adult to be nearby and stop if anything feels unsafe. You may always describe a choice instead of performing it. One deliberate artistic choice with a named effect is more useful than a longer praise sentence.
